original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 Serial Number exactly matches the authorized asset record and persists after reboot without exposing the identifier outside the approved evidence boundary.
original_method: Collect full Type 1 into protected storage, extract the record-scoped Serial Number, compare to the trusted asset reference and corroborating product/UUID, execute the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user supplies the protected reference and approves the plan. Protected collection, exact comparison and reboot are automatable.
required_inputs: Evidence access, redaction and retention policy
safety_requirements: Store raw Type 1 and serial only in approved access-controlled evidence; do not echo it to chat/public logs.
Reject blank, placeholder, duplicate or wrong-asset values.
Stop on identity mismatch, evidence exposure, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect protected Type 1/tool/asset evidence, compare exact serial through a non-public result and repeat after the approved reboot.
Do not alter DMI, disclose the identifier or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve asset mapping and protected reference/evidence policy.
Review any identity mismatch and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but grep-only output, hidden errors, insecure transport and direct identifier output are unsuitable for controlled evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved transport and protected storage; archive full Type 1/tool output, compare serial within the controlled workflow and expose only match/mismatch plus evidence ID.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, Serial Number scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare the Type 1 serial with the authoritative asset record inside the evidence boundary, bind it to UUID/product and report only controlled evidence references plus comparison status.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved asset inventory and evidence-handling policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds trusted asset provenance and identifier protection.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A syntactically valid unique serial is not proof of correct provisioning without the trusted reference.

project_override_considerations: A project may redact displayed serial evidence while retaining controlled raw proof. Redaction must not prevent exact comparison.
expected_evidence: Approval, protected asset reference/mapping and tool version
Protected raw pre-reboot Type 1 and comparison result/evidence ID
Engineer verdict without unnecessary identifier disclosure

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently define the serial check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field/method are clear; missing asset reference or protected store affects readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains dmidecode but adds asset trust and identifier protection.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps protected evidence/recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automated comparison from the engineer verdict and limits serial disclosure.

review_improvement: Prevents a serial from being accepted merely because it is populated and avoids leaking an asset identifier through review evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: With an approved protected reference and plan, every core step is software-controlled; evidence sensitivity does not make the case PARTIAL, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
